title: Contrast x coil factorized MRI Mirror prior — amendment 01
hypothesis: For a 3x3 synthetic multi-contrast and coil-domain grid with cell (2,2) withheld, an additive contrast-plus-coil Givens chart fitted only from the other eight cells improves held-out-cell NMSE over both hard sharing and a byte-matched native additive scalar chart; a separate-cell adaptation is only an upper control.
prior_art_delta: PA306 already studies continuous contrast conditioning; test whether the functional effect factorizes contrast from coil identity and generalizes to an unseen pair beyond ordinary scalar conditioning.

data.type: deterministic analytic synthetic complex phantoms; no acquired MRI
data.support_seeds: 1008101 + 100*c + 10*k + i, i=0..3 for each observed pair

model.unroll: one explicit SENSE adjoint initialization followed by prior; same mask/coil map/FFT path for every method
model.code: For each of the eight observed contrast-coil cells, fit one scalar or one Givens angle on four support phantoms; least-squares project the eight fitted cell codes onto a gauge-fixed additive chart: global offset + two contrast effects + two coil effects (five coordinates). Predict withheld cell (2,2) from the chart. Also report target-specific code/full fine-tune as non-transfer upper controls using separate target support.

controls: factorized_scalar_film projected from eight observed cell codes
factorized_givens_mirror projected from eight observed cell codes
eight-entry direct code bank for storage and observed-cell reconstruction audit

training.selection: No hyperparameter search. Frozen chart is determined only by eight observed cells; held-out target support used only for the separate upper controls.
training.observed_cell_code_adaptation_updates: 80 per cell x 8 cells per code family

storage.comparison: Serialize common model and physics metadata identically; direct bank carries eight float32 pair codes, factorized Mirror carries five float32 coordinates. Include complete torch.save payload bytes.

success_gate: On held-out cell (2,2), Mirror NMSE at least 5% lower than hard sharing and factorized scalar control, within 10% of target-specific upper control, and its actual total payload at least 20% below an eight-code direct Givens bank for the observed cells while preserving the same explicit multicoil operator. Report known-cell retention before any fresh opening.
failure_gate: Mirror fails to beat both hard sharing and factorized scalar control, or loses the predeclared known-cell retention/storage gate, or alters forward/adjoint physics.
boundaries: Synthetic mechanism screen only, not fastMRI data, clinical quality, or scanner validation.
One held-out contrast-coil pair and a single fixed architecture.
No hyperparameter tuning or fresh access after seeing development outcome.

amendment_01.reason: Original first-pass screen fit factor coordinates on held-out target support and therefore did not test unseen contrast-coil generalization. Preserve its output as exploratory; exclude it from the amended decision. Amendment freezes the heldout cell and fits the chart from the other eight cells only. No fresh metrics had been accessed before amendment.

failure_gate_result: Development FAIL: Mirror NMSE 0.021623 vs hard sharing 0.021697 (0.34% better) and factorized scalar 0.021537 (0.40% worse); target full-prior fine-tune 0.015390. Matched shared-prior bank payload is 10,129 B for both eight direct codes and five factor coordinates (0% total-byte reduction). All quality/storage gates missed; fresh remains sealed.
